ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا الْأُخْرَى ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَوَلَّيْتُم is in the derivative form: تَوَلَّى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ل/ي   w–l–y adjacency
; to follow; to turn to/from; to befriend, to back up; to take control; helper, backer, guardian, benefactor; next of kin; patron, servant/master; companion, partner. As adjacency is the central meaning

of this root some derivatives denote opposite meanings, e.g. master/servant. Of this root, 12 forms occur 233 times in the Qur’an:
يَلِي yalı 1 time; وَلَّى wallā 30 times; تَوَلَّى tawallā 79 times; وَالِي wālı 1 time; مُوَلِّي muwallı 1 time; وَلِيٌّ waliyy 44 times; أَوْلِيَاء ʾawliyāʾ 42 times; وَلاَيَةٌ walāyatun 2 times; أَوْلَى ʾawlā 11 times; أَوْلَيَان ʾawlayān 1 time; مَوْلَى mawlā 18 times and مَوَالِي mawālı 3 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَوَلَّى tawallā [v. V] I [intrans.]

1 to leave, to go one’s own way

(2:205) وَإِذَا تَوَلَّى سَعَى فِى الأَرْضِ لِيُفْسِدَ فِيهَا and when he goes away [from you] he sets out in the land to spread corruption therein

2 to turn away, to run away

(3:155) إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا مِنْكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ those of you who turned away on the day the two armies met [in battle]

3 to wander off, to withdraw

(28:24) فَسَقَى لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّى إِلَى الظِّلِّ he watered [their flock] for them, then withdrew into the shade *

(51:39) فَتَوَلَّى بِرُكْنِهِ [Pharaoh] drew power from his position, he turned away [also interpreted as: he drew power from his supporters] II [trans.]

1 to take charge of, to take upon oneself

(24:11) وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ he who took upon himself the greatest part in it will have a painful chastisement

2 to ally oneself to, to seek support from, to give support to

(5:56) وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا فَإِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ whoever allies themselves to God, His Messenger and those who believe–the party of God surely will be triumphant.

entries.label: أَوْلَى
entries.definitionHtml:
أَوْلَى ʾawlā [elat.] more/most deserving, having more/most right or claim to

(3:68) إِنَّ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا the people who are the most deserving of Abraham[’s legacy] are those who truly follow him, this Prophet, and those who believe; *

(75:34) أَوْلَى لـَكَ either from وَلِيَ waliya, to come closely behind, (elliptically) [your end is] nearer to you, or from وَيْل wayl, agony; distress, woe to you!

entries.label: أَوْلَيَانِ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَوْلَيَانِ ʾawlayān [dual n.] the two more/most deserving, the two having more/most priority, the nearer/nearest; closer/closest

(5:107) فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَى أَنَّهُمَا اسْتَحَقَّا إِثْمًا فَآخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الأَوْلَيَانِ if it is discovered that these two have committed [lit. a sin] perjury, two others [should] replace them from among those of the family of the deceased whose rights have been usurped, being the ones more deserving of standing witness (or, being the nearer to the deceased).

entries.label: مَوْلَى
entries.definitionHtml:
مَوْلَى mawlā [quasi‐act. part./n., pl. مَوَالِي mawālı]

1 master, protector, patron

(22:78) وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلاَكُمْ and hold fast to God–He is your Protector

2 ally, friend

(44:41) يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا a Day when no friend can take another’s place

3 kinfolk, dependants

(19:5) وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَرَائِي I fear [what] my kinfolk [may do] after me

4 [jur.] a freed slave

(33:5) فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا ءَابَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِى الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ if you do not know their fathers, [address them as] your brothers‐in‐religion and mawālı (i.e., wards, protégés)

5 inheritor, heir

(4:33) وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالأَقْرَبُونَ and for everything that parents and close relatives leave behind We have appointed heirs.

entries.label: مُوَلِّي
entries.definitionHtml:
مُوَلِّي muwallı [act. part.] one facing or turning to or towards something, one causing someone to face or turn towards something

(2:148) وَلِكُلٍّ وِجْهَةٌ هُوَ مُوَلِّيهَا for each one there is a direction he takes (or, according to another interpretation: He [God] directs him towards it).

entries.label: وَالِي
entries.definitionHtml:
وَالِي wālı [act. part.] protector, supporter, guardian, ally

(13:11) وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ وَالٍ apart from Him, they have no protector.

entries.label: وَلاَيَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَلاَيَةٌ walāyatun (also وِلاَيَةٌ wilāyatun) [v. n./n.]

1 support, backing, succour

(8:72) وَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ وَلاَيَتِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى يُهَاجِرُوا and those who believed but did not emigrate, you have nothing whatsoever to do with their protection until they emigrate

2 sovereignty, sovereign power

(18:44) الْوَلاَيَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ sovereignty is for God [alone], the True One.

entries.label: وَلِيٌّ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَلِيٌّ waliyy [quasi‐act. part./n., pl. أَوْلِيَاء ʾawliyāʾ]

1 protector, patron, ally

(6:14) أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ shall I take for myself a protector other than God, the Creator of the heavens and the earth?

2 follower, ward, protégé

(10:62) أَلاَ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ as for those who are close to God [lit. follower, or, ward of God], there [should] be no concern about them, nor shall they grieve

3 ally, friend

(3:28) لاَ يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْكَافِرِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ the believers should not take the disbelievers as friends/allies in preference to believers

4 [jur.] legal guardian

(2:282) فَإِنْ كَانَ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُ بِالْعَدْلِ if the debtor is feeble‐minded, weak or unable to dictate, then let his guardian dictate justly

5 [jur.] next of kin

(17:33) وَمَنْ قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِ سُلْطَانًا and whoever is slain unjustly–We have given mandate to the custodian of his rights

6 descendant, heir

(19:5–6) فَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا يَرِثُنِي so grant me a successor who will inherit me.

entries.label: وَلَّى
entries.definitionHtml:
وَلَّى wallā [v. II] I [intrans.]

1 to turn away, to recoil

(31:7) وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ ءَايَاتُنَا وَلَّى مُسْتَكْبِرًا when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away disdainfully

2 to turn, to face

(2:115) فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ wherever you turn, there is God’s face II [trans.]

1 to turn something

(2:177) لَيْسَ الْبِرَّ أَنْ تُوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ goodness does not [merely] consist in turning your face towards East or West [in any particular direction]

2 [with prep. عن] to make turn away

(2:142) مَا وَلاَّهُمْ عَنْ قِبْلَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا عَلَيْهَا what has made them turn away from the prayer direction they used to face? *

(48:22) لَوَلَّوُا الأَدْبَارَ they would have taken flight [lit. turned their backs /tails] III [doubly trans.]

1 to cause something to turn away from

(8:15) فَلاَ تُوَلُّوهُمُ الأَدْبَارَ never turn your backs on them

2 to give authority over, to cause to be inclined towards

(6:129) وَكَذَلِكَ نُوَلِّي بَعْضَ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضًا in this way, We give some of the unjust power over others; *

(4:115) نُوَلِّهِ مَا تَوَلَّى We will leave him to his own devices [lit. turn him towards his chosen path].

entries.label: يَلِي
entries.definitionHtml:
يَلِي yalı [imperf. of v. وَلِيَ waliya, trans.] to be adjacent to, to be alongside, to be next in place, time or relationship

(9:123) قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُمْ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ fight those of the disbelievers who are next to you.
